$comment: Who may publish @passioncode-ai/passioncode, and the npm registry key its signatures must verify against. The session-start hook auto-updates only to a version whose every npm maintainer and publisher is listed here, whose registry signature verifies with a key listed here, and which carries SLSA build provenance; see SECURITY.md. github-actions-oidc is this repository's release.yml publishing through npm trusted publishing (registered by a maintainer). npmRegistryKeys is copied from https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/keys; a key npm rotates in is added here in a release before npm signs with it.
